query:
SELECT cm.mod_id,
                        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT c.id) filter (where c.id is not null) collection_ids
                    FROM collections_mods cm
                    INNER JOIN collections c ON c.id = cm.collection_id
                    WHERE cm.mod_id = ANY($1)
                        AND c.status = $2
                        AND (c.flags & $3) = $3
                    GROUP BY cm.mod_id
